title: Canned job is added without its inactive parts and one warning names them
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), a role that has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Create & Edit' and 'Delete'.
  • Inventory parts {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CANNED-01) and {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CANNED-02) are tracked at {Location-A} with 4 in their default bins and are inactive.
  • Inventory part {Part-C} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CANNED-03) is tracked at {Location-A} with 4 in its default bin and is active.
  • Canned job {Canned-job-A} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST PL CANNEDSRC line") holds {Part-A}, {Part-B} and {Part-C}, one of each, saved while all three were active.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15440) at {Location-A} is open and has no lines.
custom_steps:
1. Open {Work-order-1}.
  2. Click "New Line".
  3. Type the start of {Canned-job-A} in Title.
  4. Pick the {Canned-job-A} suggestion.
  5. Click "Save & Close".
  6. Read the warning at the bottom right.
  7. Wait 10 seconds. Do not close the warning.
  8. Click "Close" on the warning.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: The suggestion reads {Canned-job-A} with "Total Parts: 3".
  • Step 5: {Work-order-1} gets a new line {Canned-job-A} holding one part, {Part-C}. {Part-A} and {Part-B} are not on it.
  • Step 6: Exactly one warning shows for the whole canned job: "These parts are inactive and were not added: {Part-A}, {Part-B}." Each part is named by its number as it shows on the Inactive tab (the PRD does not set the order of the two numbers).
  • Step 7: The warning is still on screen after 10 seconds.
  • Step 8: The warning closes.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S9-R9, S9-R10, S9-R10b, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas boards 6.4 (A canned job that holds it) and 6.5 (The canned job leaves it out: "These parts are inactive and were not added: GREASETUBE."), 13 Oct copy. Tech plan "Parts Lifecycle Update — Technical Implementation Plan", 7 Oct 2026 (informs, never overrules), §6 Phase 7. Product's 9 Oct answer (Chris Ward, question 7): the part's own number, as it shows on the Inactive tab. Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-R9: “Applying a canned job adds the job without its inactive parts.”
  • S9-R10: “When a canned job leaves out parts, the system shows one warning listing every part left out: "These parts are inactive and were not added: {part numbers}." The warning stays until the user closes it.”
  • S9-R10b: “The warning names each part by the inventory part's own number, as it shows on the Inactive tab, not by the number as typed in the canned job.”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Canned job leaves out inactive parts): “"These parts are inactive and were not added: {part numbers}." plus "The {fee} fee for {part number} was not added." for each fee left out | Warning toast, one per canned job, stays until closed”
  • Tech plan (Parts Lifecycle Update, 7 Oct 2026), §6 Phase 7 browser-walk: “a canned job containing it and a second inactive part shows one warning naming both”
